items.title: Gallery View Everywhere
items.subtitle: Browse Home, Popular, All, and any profile as a media grid, now with real video controls and rotation.

items.title: Live Interactive Posts
items.subtitle: Live match threads, games, and other interactive posts now play inline instead of showing a placeholder.

items.title: Scrub Feed Videos
items.subtitle: Slide along an inline video's progress bar to seek, and let feed videos play with sound.

items.title: Redesigned Icon Picker
items.subtitle: Browse icon packs as cards, discover a new Daily Spotlight, and pin any icon to Light or Dark artwork.

items.title: Goodbye Wallpapers
items.subtitle: Apollo's farewell wallpapers are back for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, ready to save straight to Photos.

items.title: Stability & Fixes
items.subtitle: Crash fixes, no more hijacked video ads, smoother scrolling, and better link, tweet, and sports-clip previews.
